meta.expect: Moves one position at a time on evidence, ends at the rewrite to put this behind him; debrief Where she ended says fair outcome; What she never said names the laptop and how close the 11:31 PM times came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's essay. Start with why he has a zero.
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Then you know what that does to the zero. What do you have?
Here's the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen, read it yourself.
Writing that down. He's been up late all term, and a document pasted in from somewhere else looks exactly like that. Who decided on the zero from this, and where was my call?
If he drafted somewhere else, he can bring me that file with its dates, and I'll look at it with you.
Okay, Hale. If that file exists, Owen will bring it, and whatever happens, none of this goes on his record. Is anything on it right now, and what else do you have?
Second: the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in the play. Here's the act. Search it.
Which line, and where is it in the essay? Give me both and I'll search it myself.
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and no errors.
Forty minutes in a classroom isn't a weekend at a desk. I'll read that sample and the essay side by side. You still haven't given me the line from Act 3, and that's what I want on paper.

Under 4.4 this is a first concern. I'm offering a supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
Okay. I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him, in writing tonight, private, with nothing on his file. Put a date on it, with the new mark in before December 1.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed that Owen will do a private supervised rewrite under 4.4, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes on his record. I still want a date for the rewrite, the new mark entered before December 1, and the line from Act 3 you never gave me. I expect all of it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and accepted a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, to put this behind him, and she still wants a date for it, the new mark in before December 1 and the Act 3 line; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time never ran out.
What moved her: You answered her defence that he drafted somewhere else by offering to look at that file with its dates, because it gave her something she could check herself.
What cost ground: Nothing, since you owned entering the zero before calling her in one sentence and never defended it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with its edits near midnight the night before the essay was due came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked which line from Act 3 was not in the play, name the line and where it sits in the essay before moving to your next piece, so the strongest evidence is on paper rather than left hanging.
